Name: Time Is Gold
Author: YellowCow3790
Description:
[b]Time Is Gold[/b]
[i]Time Is Gold[/i] is a mod where money drains over time.
By default, every 10 in-game minutes:

[list]
[*][b]Year 1:[/b] 10G is deducted[/*]
[*][b]Year 2:[/b] 20G is deducted[/*]
[*][b]Year 3:[/b] 100G is deducted[/*]
[/list]
If you don't have enough money, [b]stamina[/b] is consumed instead. If stamina runs out too, you will [b]pass out[/b] and be sent home.
[b]Deduction Order:[/b] Money → Stamina → Pass out

[b]Default values (per 10 minutes):[/b]
[list]
[*]Money: 10G[/*]
[*]Stamina: 5[/*]
[*]Health: 5[/*]
[/list]
[b]Requirements:[/b] SMAPI

Prove your worth — can your money survive the test of time?
